msg.civilizacion_nether.burst_not_ready: The burst is not charged yet (%s/%s). Shoot with right click to charge it.
msg.civilizacion_nether.king_offering: %s accepts your offering (%s/%s enchanted golden apples)
msg.civilizacion_nether.need_saddle: Put a saddle on the dragon to ride it.
msg.civilizacion_nether.ride_hint: Look up and move forward (W) to take off. Right click: fireball. 3 shots charge the bar → R: big burst. X: dragon camera.
msg.civilizacion_nether.too_young: %s is too small to ride (%s%% grown). Keep feeding it meat or fish.
msg.civilizacion_nether.dragon_adult: %s is now an adult! Put a saddle on it and right click to fly.
msg.civilizacion_nether.egg_placed: Egg placed. It hatches in about 5 minutes (half that near lava, magma or fire).
msg.civilizacion_nether.egg_adopted: This egg is yours now: it started incubating.
msg.civilizacion_nether.egg_time: The egg will hatch in about %s seconds.
msg.civilizacion_nether.egg_heat: The egg will hatch in about %s seconds (the heat speeds it up).
msg.civilizacion_nether.egg_hatched: Your Nether Dragon hatched! Feed it meat or fish so it grows.
msg.civilizacion_nether.staff_none: None of your dragons is nearby (or the bound one is not loaded).
msg.civilizacion_nether.staff_free: %s roams free: it walks, flies and rests on its own.
tooltip.civilizacion_nether.staff_unboun: Unbound: calls all your nearby dragons (right click a dragon to bind it)
tooltip.civilizacion_nether.staff_use: Right click: your dragon flies or walks to you
tooltip.civilizacion_nether.staff_use2: Sneak + right click: free mode / follow you
tooltip.civilizacion_nether.soul_scythe: Break soul sand: drops 1 to 3 souls
tooltip.civilizacion_nether.dragon_egg: Place it on the ground: hatches in ~5 min (faster with heat)
tooltip.civilizacion_nether.dragon_egg2: The hatchling will be yours. It grows by eating meat and fish.
tooltip.civilizacion_nether.necro_staff_: Sneak + right click: summons 2 Soul Minions
tooltip.civilizacion_nether.dragon_armor: Use it on a tamed dragon
